text.text: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be delivered: for in mount Zion and in Jerusalem shall be deliverance, as the Lord hath said, and in the remnant whom the Lord shall call.
But thou hast not called upon me, O Jacob; but thou hast been weary of me, O Israel.
And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.
